attachments_owner_check.name: attachments_owner_check
attachments_owner_check.value: "attachments"."project_id" is not null or "attachments"."conversation_id" is not null

conversations_scope_ids_check.name: conversations_scope_ids_check
conversations_scope_ids_check.value:
("conversations"."kind" in ('personal', 'intake'))
        OR ("conversations"."kind" = 'project' AND "conversations"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."work_item_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("conversations"."kind" = 'work_item' AND "conversations"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."work_item_id" IS NOT NULL)

knowledge_entries_scope_ids_check.name: knowledge_entries_scope_ids_check
knowledge_entries_scope_ids_check.value:
("knowledge_entries"."scope" = 'department' AND "knowledge_entries"."project_id" IS NULL AND "knowledge_entries"."work_item_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("knowledge_entries"."scope" = 'project' AND "knowledge_entries"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge_entries"."work_item_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("knowledge_entries"."scope" = 'work_item' AND "knowledge_entries"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge_entries"."work_item_id" IS NOT NULL)

settings_secret_complete.name: settings_secret_complete
settings_secret_complete.value: ("settings"."ciphertext" is null) = ("settings"."key_id" is null) and ("settings"."ciphertext" is null) = ("settings"."wrapped_dek" is null) and ("settings"."ciphertext" is null) = ("settings"."dek_nonce" is null) and ("settings"."ciphertext" is null) = ("settings"."nonce" is null)
